He's going about it the proper way by talking to my guardian (since my father is not muslim) and his parents have agreed. But now I have a big problem. I understand in Islam that women and men shouldn't talk more than business. He asked me to delete the friends from my internet accounts who I didn't even talk to. Is it right for him to keep his female aqaintances when I can't? I've told him my feelings and I don't like it. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 9327 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalaam u alaikum.. Jinaab mufti sahab,my name is naveed akram and basically i am from Kashmir,india but currently i am a student of business administration in United Kingdom and for my daily expenses i do part time work. If i dont work part time i will not be able to survive because my father will not be able to send me money. I am working as a kitchen assistant in a fast food here like MC Donalds and they serve haraam food. So i have to ccok and prepare that sometimes for customers. But i never eat that and inshallah will never do that. Now my question is that my friend told me that whatever i earn is also haraam because i deal with haraam food products like beef burgers, chicken burgers and other beef products. Not everything is haraam. they also have patato chips, fruit juices, vegetable burgers, but there is no alcohol or alcohol products. so is my earning haraam as i am required to deal with the said products. Question: Assalaam u alaikum.. Jinaab mufti sahab,my name is naveed akram and basically i am from Kashmir,india but currently i am a student of business administration in United Kingdom and for my daily expenses i do part time work. If i dont work part time i will not be able to survive because my father will not be able to send me money. I am working as a kitchen assistant in a fast food here like MC Donalds and they serve haraam food. So i have to ccok and prepare that sometimes for customers. But i never eat that and inshallah will never do that. Now my question is that my friend told me that whatever i earn is also haraam because i deal with haraam food products like beef burgers, chicken burgers and other beef products. Not everything is haraam. they also have patato chips, fruit juices, vegetable burgers, but there is no alcohol or alcohol products. so is my earning haraam as i am required to deal with the said products. Answer ID: 9327 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1258/1258=M/1429) The products you deal in include, according to you, halal and haram items, then all of your salary shall not be regarded haram . As far as haram products are concerned, you should excuse clearly to the owner of restaurant that you will not prepare the haram items. There is no wrong in preparing the halal items and the salary also shall be halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
